description: Security Officers oversee the operations, administration, and training of security units, incorporating advanced risk assessment, SOP development, and multi-site coordination. They leverage modern tools such as IoT-enabled systems, cloud-based platforms, and virtual learning solutions to enhance efficiency and ensure compliance with updated security standards. Their responsibilities include deployment, incident management, documentation, and liaising with stakeholders.
